next.reason: 1985: a character-string 'consists of certain allowable combinations of characters ... The allowable combinations determine the category'. §2023:13.18.40.3 SR2 keeps 'an allowable combination of characters used as picture symbols' and §2023:13.18.40.4 GR3 keeps 'A PICTURE clause defines the subject of the entry to fall into one of the following categories', but the categories now include boolean, national and national-edited, with their symbols: strings such as PIC 1 or PIC N, not allowable in 1985 and so refused, are accepted, so CHANGED. The currency-symbol note is not the difference: 1985 already let the CURRENCY SIGN literal be 'any character from the computer's character set' (§1985:VI.4.5.4).
